clue.text: Outline permission is required

indicators.note: read as re-quired, folded again, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A planning application for an outline scheme needs official consent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outline permission' looks like planning jargon, but 'Outline' is the definition and 'required', taken as re-quired, rearranges PERMISSION.
explanation.definitionFit: An impression can be a rough sketch or general shape, as an outline is.

clue.text: Common where there's a stretch of water

definitions.meaning: as an adjective, ordinary or nothing more than
a lake or pond, a word found in English place names

explanation.surface: A village common with a pond on it.
explanation.definitionFit: The word serves both as an adjective for something simply ordinary and as a noun for a small lake.

clue.text: Proceeds-note the change

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a turn is a change, as in a turn for the better

explanation.surface: A banker telling us that money raised has changed hands.
explanation.definitionFit: Proceeds are the profit or yield that an investment brings in.

clue.text: Casual worker given run around

definitions.meaning: one who scamps work, doing it hastily and carelessly

explanation.surface: A temp sent on errands all over the place.
explanation.definitionFit: To scamp a job is to skimp it, so a careless worker is a scamper; and to scamper is to scurry about.

clue.text: Greek character from Rio taking liberties

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the words that follow, across the gap between them

explanation.surface: A Greek visitor misbehaving in Rio de Janeiro.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Managed to raise charge for report

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising a word writes it from the bottom up, so it reads backwards

parts.note: ran a business means managed it
a rate is a charge or fee

explanation.surface: Someone managing to put up prices for a report.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate is to tell or give an account of events.

clue.text: Fidelity-for instance within marriage

indicators.note: says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a marriage is an alliance between two people or families
e.g. is the abbreviation for exempli gratia, for instance

explanation.surface: Faithfulness as an example of what a marriage needs.
explanation.definitionFit: Allegiance is loyalty or faithfulness owed to a person or cause.

clue.text: Even about cigarette ends he's at odds with others

indicators.note: says the first piece wraps round the second

parts.note: even, as in an even pace, means constant
the final pair of letters of the word cigarette

explanation.surface: Someone constantly stubbing out cigarettes and quarrelling with everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cigarette ends' means the final pair of letters, not just the last one or the first and last; 'about' wraps CONSTANT round them.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor is pitted against rivals, so he is set against the others.

clue.text: Some cereals only are allowed in addition

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A diet rule saying certain cereals are permitted as extras.
explanation.definitionFit: Something allowed in addition is included as well, which is what the adverb means.

clue.text: A measuring device for farm machinery

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a tractor is the farm vehicle that hauls implements

explanation.surface: A gauge designed for use with farm equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A protractor is an instrument for measuring angles.

clue.text: LAn animal's lair amid rubbish

indicators.note: says one piece sits in the middle of the other

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish
a den is an animal's lair

explanation.surface: A creature's home in the middle of a rubbish tip.
explanation.definitionFit: A rat or mouse is an animal of the gnawing order.

clue.text: Rest can result in one's getting thinner

indicators.note: the letters of the words before it produce a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Lying down to rest as a way to lose weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Scanter is a comparative meaning more meagre or slighter.

clue.text: Appears distressed-a head-rest's called for

indicators.note: the letters are summoned into a different order

parts.note: these letters, the possessive S included, are the material rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone upset in a car needing a head-rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To weep is to show that one is upset.

clue.text: Explain the current number in favour

parts.note: AC is alternating current
a count is a number or total
being for something is being in favour of it

explanation.surface: Justify the latest figures in support of a motion.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a reason or justification for something.

clue.text: Making drier comment

indicators.note: says the letters of the next word are made into something else

explanation.surface: A remark that makes the conversation drier.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider is an added remark or clause attached to a statement.

clue.text: Urges transport aboard

annotationWithheld.why: Urges transport aboard (7): TRAIN inside SS, but 'aboard' must both supply SS and signal the insertion, one word doing two jobs

clue.text: Sort of share the golfer aims to avoid

definitions.meaning: a portion, as in a ... of the profits
a shot that curves sharply off line

explanation.surface: A golfer anxious not to lose a share of the prize.
explanation.definitionFit: A portion of a whole, and a wayward golf shot curving away to the right for a right-hander.

clue.text: The weapon of a novice in general

indicators.note: says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: rife means widespread or general
L is the learner sign, for a novice driver

explanation.surface: A recruit's weapon, issued to a general.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle is a long-barrelled firearm.

clue.text: Every one starts even with a small child

indicators.note: takes the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: ch is a short form of child

explanation.surface: Each person begins level with a little one.
explanation.definitionFit: Each refers to every single one of a group taken individually.

clue.text: A woman will arrange articles back-to back

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: the second copy faces the opposite way to the first

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A woman arranging items in rows facing away from each other.
explanation.definitionFit: A common female given name.

clue.text: Consequently she goes to church

parts.note: a hen is a female bird
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Therefore she attends church.
explanation.definitionFit: Hence means for this reason or therefore.

clue.text: Showing ardour to a girl is a bloomer!

parts.note: heat means passion or ardour
her refers to a girl

explanation.surface: A suitor whose passion for a girl is a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' looks like a blunder, but here it is something that blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Heather is a flowering moorland shrub.

clue.text: Egghead behind Oriental

parts.note: the head, or first letter, of the word egg
astern means behind, at the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A clever person following an Asian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' is not an intellectual: it is the head of 'Egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: Eastern describes things from the East, as oriental does.

clue.text: A way to speak, but speak with a certain hesitation

definitions.meaning: a speech impediment, a manner of speaking

explanation.surface: Describing a halting manner of talking.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names a speech impediment and the verb means talking with repeated hesitations.

clue.text: Letters are sent-that could be serious

indicators.note: says the letters of the words given could form something else

explanation.surface: Letters sent off for something serious.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest means sincere and serious in intention.

clue.text: Wise man setting muddled notes right

indicators.note: the letters of the word beside it are mixed up

explanation.surface: A sage correcting confused notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Nestor was the aged, wise counsellor of the Greeks in Homer, and his name means a wise old man.

clue.text: A flier snapped, showing little delicacy

parts.note: a tit is a small bird
bit, as a dog snaps at someone

explanation.surface: A bird snapping up a morsel.
explanation.definitionFit: A titbit is a small tasty piece of food.

clue.text: Check support

definitions.meaning: a stalk holding up a flower or leaf

explanation.surface: Inspect the support.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to stop a flow; the noun is the stalk bearing a plant's leaves or flowers.

clue.text: Neat children turned up

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning a word upward writes it bottom to top

parts.note: tots are small children

explanation.surface: Tidy youngsters arrive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' means cattle, an old word; a stot is a young bullock.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat is an old word for cattle, and a stot is a young steer or bullock.

clue.text: Some South African people take warm drinks about ten

indicators.note: says the first pieces wrap round the second

parts.note: hot means very warm
tots are small measures of spirits
taken as written

explanation.surface: South Africans having hot drinks around ten o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: An old, now offensive, name for the Khoikhoi people of southern Africa.

clue.text: In the highest position at work

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone at the top of their career.
explanation.definitionFit: Atop means on the top of, in the uppermost place.

clue.text: May be meaner, true, yet offer payment

indicators.note: says the letters given may form something else

explanation.surface: A stingy but honest employer still paying up.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay someone for work or services rendered.
